correctness.rationale: Two distinct right quaternionic lines split H²; a third graph has nonzero invertible t and forces b_it=ta_i, hence conjugation to repeated diagonal. Fixed lines then form projective space over the joint quaternion centralizer. The normalizer of D(H) in GL2(H) has dimension 7, and noncommuting a1,a2 generate D(H), yielding dimension 16+4r-7. The packaged checker confirms exact centralizer ranks, not the infinite theorem.
